text: 整体来看，多家券商对四季度的A股均保持了一定程度的乐观态度。例如，浙商证券便预计，四季度“菱形结构”仍将延续，特别是对四季度的国内政策、宽基估值评价中性偏乐观，因此总体对A股市场走势保持中性乐观态度。
text_en: Overall, a number of brokerages have maintained a certain degree of optimism about A-shares in the fourth quarter. For example, Zheshang Securities expects that the "diamond structure" will continue in the fourth quarter, and takes a neutral-to-optimistic view of domestic policy and broad-based valuations in the fourth quarter, so it generally holds a neutral-to-optimistic attitude toward the A-share market's performance.
